name: C++
note: clang++ compiles each C++ controller into its own program (ADR 0099). A controller is one header-only class in server/controllers, and its markers are standard attributes: `class [[RequestRoute("/orders")]] [[Public]] OrdersController` and `[[GetRoute]]` on the method declare GET /orders. A parameter says where its value comes from with `[[FromPath]]`, `[[FromQuery]]`, `[[FromBody]]`, `[[FromHeader]]` or `[[FromCookie]]`. The method returns a value: `bool`, a number, `std::string`, `std::vector`, `std::optional`, `tachyon::json::JsonNode` or a model from server/models, and Tachyon writes it as JSON with status 200. `void` and an empty `std::optional` answer 204. Tachyon writes the JSON code of every model, because C++ has no reflection. A C++ controller has no services, middleware, error handlers, sockets, relays or test units yet: their markers stop the build (most with TY1308) and the message says that C++ gets them in a later step.
